privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: In compliance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Organic Law 3/2018 (LOPDGDD), users are informed of this privacy policy.

data_collected.title: Collected Data:
data_collected.desc: We may collect information such as name, email address, phone number, and any data provided through contact forms, as well as browsing data.

purpose.title: Purpose of Processing:
purpose.desc: The data is used to manage requests, provide services, communicate with the user, and improve the website user experience.

legal_basis.title: Legal Basis:
legal_basis.desc: Data processing is based on user consent, performance of a contract, or compliance with legal obligations.

retention.title: Data Retention:
retention.desc: Data will be retained for as long as necessary to fulfill the purpose for which it was collected or until the user requests its erasure.

transfers.title: Data Disclosure:
transfers.desc: Data will not be disclosed to third parties except under legal obligation or when necessary for providing the service (e.g., hosting providers).

rights.title: User Rights:

security.title: Security:

cookies_page.title: Cookie Policy
cookies_page.intro: This website uses cookies to improve user experience, analyze site usage, and, in some cases, provide personalized content.

what_are.title: What are cookies?
what_are.text: Cookies are small files stored on your device when you visit a website. They serve to remember information about your visit.

types.title: Types of cookies used
types.intro: This site uses different types of cookies:

necessary.label: Necessary
necessary.text: essential for the basic operation of the site.

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.text: allow analyzing site usage to improve experience.

marketing.label: Marketing
marketing.text: used to display relevant content or advertising.

purpose.title: Purpose of cookies
purpose.text: Cookies are used to remember your preferences, analyze site traffic, and improve the services offered.

management.title: Cookie management
management.text: You can accept, reject, or configure cookies using the management system available on this site. Your preferences are stored in your browser.

storage.title: Preference storage
storage.text: Cookie preferences are saved in your browser using local storage (localStorage), allowing your choices to be remembered on future visits.

disable.title: How to disable cookies
disable.text: You can delete or block cookies through your browser settings. Please note that some features of the site may be affected.

third_party.title: Third-party cookies
third_party.text: If analytics or marketing cookies are enabled, third-party services collecting anonymized information may be used.

legal_basis.title: Legal basis
legal_basis.text: The use of non-essential cookies is based on user consent, which can be modified at any time.

modifications.title: Modifications
modifications.text: This cookie policy may be updated to adapt to legal or technical changes to the website.
